description: Mississippi county captures and operator reviews used by tests/test_mississippi.py, from the November 2026 county collection. The original URLs were not recorded with these files; each review names its report's URL and SHA-256.

reports.zip.origin: county report captures, packed for the tests

expansion.zip.origin: further county captures, packed for the tests

rankin-2026-11-10.html.origin: Rankin County's results page as captured Nov 10, 2026

rankin-2026-11-10.json.origin: the operator's review of that page
rankin-2026-11-10.json.line_endings: stored by git with LF line endings (the hash and size are of that form)

madison-2026-11-11.pdf.origin: Madison County's report as captured Nov 11, 2026

madison-2026-11-11.json.origin: the operator's review of that report
madison-2026-11-11.json.line_endings: stored by git with LF line endings (the hash and size are of that form)
